focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业需在年底前完成碳数据合规准备
focus.summary: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入实质征税阶段。钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力和氢能等六大行业对欧出口企业，须在过渡期内完成产品嵌入碳排放数据的申报与核查。当前多数中国出口商尚未建立符合欧盟要求的碳核算体系，面临数据缺失、默认值成本高企及下游客户转嫁风险。建议企业尽快梳理对欧出口产品清单，引入第三方核查机构，并评估在供应链合同中增加碳成本分担条款。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会CBAM过渡期实施指引 · 2026.09.22
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Must Complete Carbon Data Compliance by Year-End
focus.summary_en: The transitional period of the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) will end in late 2026, with actual levies commencing in 2027. Exporters to the EU in six sectors—iron and steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity and hydrogen—must report and verify embedded emissions data during the transition. Most Chinese exporters have yet to establish an EU-compliant carbon accounting system, facing missing data, high default-value costs and cost pass-back from downstream customers. Companies should map EU-bound product lists, engage third-party verifiers, and consider carbon cost-sharing clauses in supply contracts.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission CBAM Transitional Period Implementation Guidance · 2026.09.22

case.title: 新加坡国际商事法庭承认与执行中国法院商事判决，明确互惠关系认定标准
case.summary: 新加坡国际商事法庭近期在一宗跨境买卖合同纠纷中，依据《新加坡国际商事法庭法》承认与执行中国内地法院作出的商事判决。裁决要点包括：中国法院判决具有终局性和确定性；双方存在明示或默示的互惠安排；执行不违反新加坡公共政策。该案为中新两国判决互认提供重要参考，也提示中国企业在跨境交易中应重视争议解决条款的法院选择与判决可执行性评估。建议在合同中明确约定管辖法院并保留完整送达与应诉证据。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际商事法庭案例评述 · 2026年第三季度
case.title_en: Singapore International Commercial Court Recognises and Enforces Chinese Commercial Judgment, Clarifying Reciprocity Test
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Commercial Court recently recognised and enforced a commercial judgment rendered by a mainland Chinese court in a cross-border sale-of-goods dispute under the SICC Act. Key holdings include: the Chinese judgment was final and conclusive; reciprocity existed between the parties; and enforcement did not offend Singapore public policy. The case offers important guidance on China-Singapore mutual recognition of judgments and reminds Chinese enterprises to carefully assess court selection and enforceability when drafting dispute resolution clauses. Parties should specify the governing court and preserve complete service and defence records.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Commercial Court Case Commentary · Q3 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区推出跨境商事纠纷“一站式”在线解纷平台，支持港澳调解与仲裁裁决跨境执行
policy.summary: 粤港澳大湾区近期上线跨境商事纠纷“一站式”在线解纷平台，整合粤港澳三地调解、仲裁与诉讼资源，支持在线立案、远程调解及裁决跨境执行协助。平台依托《关于内地与香港特别行政区法院相互认可和执行民商事案件判决的安排》及粤港、粤澳合作机制，为企业提供低成本、高效率的争议解决通道。建议大湾区企业优先在合同中约定该平台调解或仲裁条款，并关注港澳裁决在内地执行的程序要求，以提升跨境债权实现效率。
policy.source: 来源：粤港澳大湾区法律部门联席会议 · 2026年9月
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Launches One-Stop Online Platform for Cross-Border Commercial Dispute Resolution, Supporting Cross-Border Enforcement of HK/Macao Awards
policy.summary_en: The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area has launched a one-stop online platform for cross-border commercial dispute resolution, integrating mediation, arbitration and litigation resources across the three jurisdictions and supporting online case filing, remote mediation and cross-border enforcement assistance. Backed by the Arrangement on Mutual Recognition and Enforcement of Judgments in Civil and Commercial Matters between Mainland and Hong Kong and Guangdong-HK/Macao cooperation mechanisms, the platform offers a low-cost, efficient dispute resolution channel. GBA enterprises are advised to incorporate platform mediation or arbitration clauses into contracts and to note procedural requirements for enforcing HK/Macao awards on the mainland.
policy.source_en: Source: Joint Meeting of GBA Legal Departments · September 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对华半导体出口管制新规下，企业应建立“穿透式”供应链合规审查机制
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国近期进一步收紧对华半导体及先进计算出口管制，扩大实体清单与外国直接产品规则适用范围，第三国转口、代工及技术服务均可能触发合规风险。企业应建立“穿透式”供应链合规审查机制，向上追溯至最终用户与最终用途，向下审查分销商与客户，并在合同中嵌入出口管制陈述保证、审计权及终止条款。对涉及美国技术、软件或设备的交易，建议事前进行许可评估并保留完整合规记录，以应对可能的执法问询与民事处罚。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球涉外合规团队 · 2026.09.22
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Under New U.S. Semiconductor Export Controls, Companies Should Build 'Look-Through' Supply Chain Compliance Reviews
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The United States has further tightened export controls on semiconductors and advanced computing to China, expanding the Entity List and the foreign direct product rule, with third-country transshipment, foundry services and technical services all potentially triggering compliance risks. Companies should establish a 'look-through' supply chain compliance review mechanism—tracing upstream to end users and end uses, screening downstream distributors and customers, and embedding export control representations, audit rights and termination clauses in contracts. For transactions involving U.S. technology, software or equipment, prior licence assessments and complete compliance records are advisable to address potential enforcement inquiries and civil penalties.
analysis.source_en: Source: iGlobal Law Cross-Border Compliance Team · 2026.09.22
